description.en: Research skill for the Chinese internet: searches the last 30 days of discussion across Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, Douyin, WeChat public accounts, Baidu and Toutiao, ranks by engagement and freshness with cross-platform clustering, and returns cited Markdown, JSON or offline HTML reports. Also ships a daily cross-platform hot-search board and optional Hacker News, GitHub and Reddit sources.
description.zh: 面向中文互联网的研究技能：检索微博、小红书、B站、知乎、抖音、微信公众号、百度、今日头条最近 30 天的讨论，按互动与时效加权排序并跨平台聚类，输出附原始来源的 Markdown、JSON 或离线 HTML 报告；另含每日全网热榜与可选的 Hacker News、GitHub、Reddit 海外源。
